body: The first-aid kit and water bottle are tied together. Blue powder coats one side and has caked into the bottle's threads, and a few shriveled seedlings are stuck in it.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle, sunday after supper

body: A map and a pencil are kept together in a pocket. Three homes have been circled, but only one has been crossed off; the mark was made before the door was forced.
title: A folded address beside the raid
